title_zh: S01—S12 场景运营统一矩阵
authority_status_zh: 概念运营接口，空间、数据与责任授权尚未核实
authority_status_en: Concept operation interfaces; space, data, and responsibility authorizations are not verified
design_boundary_zh: 十二项均为可暂停、可退出的概念场景，不是已安装设施、已批准服务或效果承诺；指标只定义可审查记录，不设置无证据目标。
design_boundary_en: All twelve are pausable and exitable concept scenarios, not installed facilities, approved services, or performance commitments; metrics define reviewable records only and set no unsupported targets.

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: 众智园·校准场；既有开放空间候选与隔离沙盒
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: Zhongzhiyuan Calibration Field; candidate existing open space and isolated sandbox
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not installed or approved

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 授权传感摘要、参考站数据、合成故障
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Authorized sensor summaries, reference-station data, and synthetic faults
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 仅使用已授权或合成输入；专业人员签发校准记录，不把结果写成监管结论。
data_and_rights.rights_en: Use authorized or synthetic inputs only; a professional signs the calibration record, which is not a regulatory conclusion.

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 人工复核、工作人员记录和纸质校准记录必须可独立运行。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: Staff review, staffed records, and a paper calibration record must work independently.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录每次候选共置校准是否形成可审查记录；不衡量监管准确度或现场空气绩效。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record whether each candidate co-location calibration produces a reviewable record; do not measure regulatory accuracy or site air performance.

human_gate.gate_zh: 环境或相关专业人员核对来源、共置条件和异常解释后，才可保存内部记录；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: An environmental or relevant professional must check provenance, co-location conditions, and anomaly interpretation before an internal record is retained; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 参考条件、权利、维护或专业复核缺失时，断开设备、撤回候选输出并保留教育性静态记录。
stop_exit.en: Disconnect devices, withdraw candidate output, and retain only an educational static record when reference conditions, rights, maintenance, or professional review is missing.

risk.zh: 传感漂移被误读为监管真值。
risk.en: Sensor drift could be misread as regulatory truth.

scenarios.name_zh: 模型漂移与极端值红队
scenarios.name_en: Model drift and outlier red team

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: 众智园沙盒；隔离的模型安全测试空间
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: Zhongzhiyuan sandbox; isolated model-safety test space
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not installed or approved

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 合成事件、公开模型卡、清权测试集
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Synthetic episodes, public model cards, and cleared test sets
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 输入只用于隔离沙盒压力测试；生产系统不接收测试输出。
data_and_rights.rights_en: Inputs are for isolated-sandbox stress testing only; production systems do not receive test output.

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 工作人员红队复核、离线沙盒和纸质问题记录必须可独立运行。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: Staffed red-team review, an offline sandbox, and a paper issue record must work independently.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录合成测试事件的输入、失败类型和人工复核状态；不把通过记录解释为生产安全证明。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record the synthetic test input, failure type, and human-review state; do not interpret a pass record as proof of production safety.

human_gate.gate_zh: 独立安全审查人确认测试输入、隔离和失败解释后，才可写入内部版本记录；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: An independent safety reviewer must confirm test inputs, isolation, and failure interpretation before an internal version record is written; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 发生数据泄漏、隔离失效、基准投机或误报无法解释时，停止测试并与生产环境保持隔离。
stop_exit.en: Stop the test and keep it isolated from production when data leakage, isolation failure, benchmark gaming, or unexplained false alerts occur.

risk.zh: 数据泄漏、基准投机或误报被误作公共警报。
risk.en: Data leakage, benchmark gaming, or false alerts could be mistaken for a public warning.

scenarios.name_zh: 室内外终端可用性实验

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: 大钟寺·转化场；候选室内外公共节点
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: Dazhongsi Adoption Field; candidate indoor and outdoor public nodes
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not installed or approved

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 自愿体验、匿名任务完成记录，不含生物识别
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Voluntary trials and anonymous task-completion records, without biometrics
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 不记录人脸、声纹、个人轨迹或身份画像；参与者可删除记录并退出。
data_and_rights.rights_en: Do not record faces, voiceprints, personal traces, or identity profiles; participants may delete records and exit.

operating_generic_roles.label_zh: 公共空间或资产管护人
无障碍与公共利益审查人

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 人工主持、纸质任务和语音协助必须可独立提供服务。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: Staffed facilitation, paper tasks, and voice assistance must provide an independent service path.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录自愿匿名任务的完成、放弃和人工协助情况；不推断总体人群可用性。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record completion, abandonment, and staffed assistance for voluntary anonymous tasks; do not infer overall population usability.

human_gate.gate_zh: 人工主持与无障碍公共利益审查确认可理解、可退出和记录删除路径后，才可保留内部反馈；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: Retain internal feedback only after staffed facilitation and accessibility/public-interest review confirm legibility, exit, and record deletion paths; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 出现暗黑模式、样本偏差、设备故障、隐私疑问或等效人工路径失效时，停止体验并删除或撤回记录。
stop_exit.en: Stop the trial and delete or withdraw records when dark patterns, sample bias, device failure, privacy questions, or failure of the equivalent staffed path occur.

risk.zh: 暗黑模式、样本偏差或设备故障造成不公平体验。
risk.en: Dark patterns, sample bias, or device failure could create an inequitable experience.

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: 遗产基底蓝绿模块；小月河场景赋能翼的候选体验路径（仅为非红线概念建议）
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: Heritage-base blue-green module; candidate experience path of the Xiaoyuehe Scenario Enablement Wing (non-redline concept proposal only)
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，非道路红线、未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not a road redline, installed facility, or approved service

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 获授权的校准摘要与公开路网
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Authorized calibrated summaries and the public network
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 不存储路线历史；空气预测只是次级偏好，合法、无障碍和人工确认的通行条件优先。
data_and_rights.rights_en: Do not store route history; exposure prediction is a secondary preference, while lawful, accessible, and staff-confirmed passage takes priority.

operating_generic_roles.label_zh: 公共空间或资产管护人
无障碍与公共利益审查人

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 小月河场景赋能翼的候选体验路径必须保留静态导视、纸质地图和工作人员确认；这些是可独立使用的非 AI 路径。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: The candidate experience path of the Xiaoyuehe Scenario Enablement Wing must retain static wayfinding, a paper map, and staff confirmation as independently usable non-AI paths.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录候选路径的来源、时效、无障碍核查和人工确认状态；不衡量暴露改善或通行保证。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record provenance, freshness, accessibility checks, and staff confirmation for a candidate path; do not measure exposure improvement or guarantee passage.

human_gate.gate_zh: 运营员确认来源时效、合法通行、无障碍和现场安全后，才可展示候选路径；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: An operator must confirm provenance freshness, lawful passage, accessibility, and on-site safety before displaying a candidate path; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 预测过时、通行不安全、无障碍失败、投诉未处理或人工确认缺失时，停用提示并恢复静态导视、纸图和工作人员确认。
stop_exit.en: Disable the prompt and restore static wayfinding, the paper map, and staff confirmation when the prediction is stale, passage is unsafe, accessibility fails, a complaint is unresolved, or staff confirmation is missing.

risk.zh: 过时预测被当作通行保证，掩盖实际无障碍或交通风险。
risk.en: A stale prediction could be treated as a passage guarantee and hide actual accessibility or mobility risks.

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: 站点—公园—社区既有通道；可移动公共服务节点候选
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: Existing station–park–community paths; candidate movable public-service node
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not installed or approved

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 设施清单、自愿报障，不采身份
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Facility inventory and voluntary obstacle reports, without identity data
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 只记录获得授权的设施信息和自愿问题反馈，不宣称实时可达性。
data_and_rights.rights_en: Record authorized facility information and voluntary issue feedback only; do not claim real-time accessibility.

operating_generic_roles.label_zh: 公共空间或资产管护人
无障碍与公共利益审查人

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 纸质地图、语音协助和工作人员确认必须持续可用。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: A paper map, voice assistance, and staff confirmation must remain available.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录设施清单的核验、更新时间和自愿报障处理状态；不衡量实时可达率。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record verification, update state, and voluntary issue handling for the facility inventory; do not measure real-time accessibility rate.

human_gate.gate_zh: 现场无障碍审查人抽查设施、通行和人工服务后，才可展示清单；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: An accessibility reviewer must sample-check facilities, passage, and staffed service before the inventory is displayed; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 设施状态不明、信息过时、现场条件改变或工作人员确认缺失时，撤下对应提示并保留纸质和人工说明。
stop_exit.en: Withdraw the affected prompt and retain paper and staffed explanation when facility status is unknown, information is stale, site conditions change, or staff confirmation is missing.

risk.zh: 设施变化造成信息误导，行动不便者无法安全使用。
risk.en: Facility changes could mislead users and prevent safe use by mobility-impaired people.

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: 大钟寺候选公共室内；既有空间的概念服务接口
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: Candidate Dazhongsi public interior; concept service interface in existing space
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not installed or approved

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 授权室内传感、设备说明和人工巡检
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Authorized indoor sensors, equipment manuals, and staffed inspections
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 只提供供专业人员判断的候选提示，不将建议写成工程指令或健康判断。
data_and_rights.rights_en: Provide candidate prompts for professional judgment only; do not present advice as engineering instruction or health judgment.

operating_generic_roles.label_zh: 公共空间或资产管护人

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 工作人员巡检和纸质公告必须可独立传达信息。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: Staff inspection and a printed notice must independently communicate the information.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录专业人员对提示来源、设备说明和人工巡检的核验状态；不衡量通风性能或健康效果。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record professional verification of prompt provenance, equipment manuals, and staffed inspection; do not measure ventilation performance or health effects.

human_gate.gate_zh: 机电或卫生专业人员确认输入和现场条件后，才可发布候选提示；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: A mechanical or health professional must confirm inputs and site conditions before a candidate prompt is released; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 数据权利、机电条件、人工巡检或专业判断缺失时，关闭自动化并恢复工作人员巡检和纸质公告。
stop_exit.en: Turn off automation and restore staff inspection and the printed notice when data rights, mechanical conditions, staffed inspection, or professional judgment is missing.

risk.zh: 候选建议被误当作工程指令或健康保证。
risk.en: A candidate recommendation could be mistaken for engineering instruction or a health guarantee.

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: AI 原点社区·共译场与活动节点；公共信息候选界面
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: AI Origin Community Civic Translation Field and event nodes; candidate public-information interface
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not installed or approved

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 官方公告、授权传感和人工记录
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Official notices, authorized sensors, and staffed records
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 公报显示来源和时效，不发布医疗判断，不把传感器摘要写成监管结论。
data_and_rights.rights_en: The bulletin shows provenance and freshness, publishes no medical judgment, and does not treat a sensor summary as a regulatory conclusion.

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 静态公报、纸质通知和工作人员解释必须可独立提供信息。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: A static bulletin, paper notice, and staffed explanation must independently provide the information.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录公报使用的来源、时间、置信度和人工发布复核状态；不衡量健康或环境改善。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record the bulletin's source, time, confidence, and staffed-publication review state; do not measure health or environmental improvement.

human_gate.gate_zh: 发布员核对来源、时间和表达边界后，才可展示公报；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: A publisher must check provenance, time, and communication boundaries before displaying the bulletin; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 来源过期、权利不明、人工发布复核缺失或出现健康误导时，撤下动态提示并恢复静态公报和人工解释。
stop_exit.en: Withdraw dynamic prompts and restore the static bulletin and staffed explanation when provenance is stale, rights are unclear, staffed publication review is missing, or health misdirection occurs.

risk.zh: 来源混淆或表达不当造成健康误导。
risk.en: Source confusion or poor wording could cause health misdirection.

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: 小月河场景赋能翼与公园候选点；候选巡检路径（仅为非红线概念建议）
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: Xiaoyuehe Scenario Enablement Wing and candidate park points; candidate inspection path (non-redline concept proposal only)
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，非法定绿地或蓝线、未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not a statutory green or blue line, installed facility, or approved service

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 公开绿地层、合成图像和授权设备摘要
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Public green-space layer, synthetic images, and authorized device summaries
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 机器提示只能交给园林、水务或运维专业人员复核；不得由提示直接触发生态行动。
data_and_rights.rights_en: Machine prompts go to landscape, water, or maintenance professionals for review; a prompt must not directly trigger ecological action.

operating_generic_roles.label_zh: 公共空间或资产管护人

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 小月河场景赋能翼的候选巡检路径必须保留人工巡检和纸质检查表；二者是可独立运行的静态替代。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: The candidate inspection path of the Xiaoyuehe Scenario Enablement Wing must retain manual inspection and a paper checklist as independently usable static alternatives.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录候选设施提示是否经过专业复核并形成检查表；不衡量生态绩效或误报率。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record whether a candidate facility prompt receives professional review and produces a checklist; do not measure ecological performance or false-alert rate.

human_gate.gate_zh: 专业人员确认绿地资料、提示来源和现场条件后，才可采取维护动作；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: A professional must confirm green-space material, prompt provenance, and site conditions before any maintenance action; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 提示无法解释、专业复核缺失、数据权利不明或人工巡检不可用时，停用提示并恢复人工巡检和纸质检查表。
stop_exit.en: Disable the prompt and restore manual inspection and the paper checklist when the prompt is unexplained, professional review is missing, data rights are unclear, or manual inspection is unavailable.

risk.zh: 误报直接触发生态操作，造成蓝绿设施损害。
risk.en: A false alert could directly trigger ecological action and harm blue-green facilities.

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: 公园活动或更新候选点；活动运营信息接口
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: Candidate park event or renewal points; event-operations information interface
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not installed or approved

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 公开许可与时段、授权颗粒物摘要
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Public permits and time windows, and authorized particulate summaries
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 提示只供现场负责人判断，不能作为处罚、审批、责任或健康结论。
data_and_rights.rights_en: The notice is for the site lead's judgment only and is not a penalty, approval, liability, or health conclusion.

operating_generic_roles.label_zh: 公共空间或资产管护人

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 现场负责人判断和静态通知必须可独立完成暂停、调整或说明。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: Site-lead judgment and a static notice must independently support pause, adjustment, or explanation.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录许可与时段、输入来源、现场负责人决定和静态通知状态；不衡量活动空气效果。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record permit and time-window information, input provenance, site-lead decision, and static-notice state; do not measure event air effects.

human_gate.gate_zh: 现场负责人核对许可、时段、来源和安全冲突后，才可给出候选提示；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: The site lead must check permits, time windows, provenance, and safety conflicts before a candidate notice is shown; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 许可或时段不明、设备误报、责任边界不清或现场冲突无法处理时，停止提示并恢复静态通知和现场人工决定。
stop_exit.en: Stop the notice and restore the static notice and site-lead decision when permits or time windows are unclear, the device misfires, responsibility is unclear, or site conflict cannot be handled.

risk.zh: 责任不清、设备误报或邻里冲突扩大。
risk.en: Unclear responsibility, device false alerts, or neighborhood conflict could escalate.

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: 大钟寺转化场与园区服务界面；候选夜班公共服务点
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: Dazhongsi Adoption Field and district-service interface; candidate shift-worker public-service point
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not installed or approved

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 公开设施时段、匿名需求，不采雇佣数据
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Public facility hours and anonymous demand, without employment data
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 保留固定非 AI 服务，不采个人轨迹、雇佣绩效或身份画像。
data_and_rights.rights_en: Retain a fixed non-AI service and do not collect personal traces, employment performance, or identity profiles.

operating_generic_roles.label_zh: 公共空间或资产管护人
无障碍与公共利益审查人

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 值守人员、固定非 AI 服务和纸质时段说明必须可独立运行。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: Duty staff, a fixed non-AI service, and paper hours must work independently.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录公开服务时段、人工值守和匿名需求的核验状态；不衡量就业、消费或服务绩效。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record verification of public service hours, staffed duty, and anonymous demand; do not measure employment, consumption, or service performance.

human_gate.gate_zh: 值守人员确认开放时段、无障碍和固定非 AI 服务后，才可展示候选信息；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: Duty staff must confirm opening hours, accessibility, and the fixed non-AI service before candidate information is displayed; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 服务中断、时段不明、人工值守缺失或出现劳动监控疑问时，停用候选界面并保留固定非 AI 服务或纸质说明。
stop_exit.en: Disable the candidate interface and retain the fixed non-AI service or paper hours when service is interrupted, hours are unclear, staffed duty is missing, or labor-surveillance concerns arise.

risk.zh: 服务中断、劳动监控或排他性消费门槛。
risk.en: Service interruption, labor surveillance, or an exclusionary consumption barrier.

scenarios.name_zh: 社区传感器借用与共学

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: AI 原点社区·共译场；社区借用与共学候选接口
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: AI Origin Community Civic Translation Field; candidate community loan and learning interface
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not installed or approved

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 最小借用日志、公开教程和用户自愿数据
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Minimal loan logs, public tutorials, and voluntary user data
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 借用日志最小化；数据可以不公开并可按授权规则删除。
data_and_rights.rights_en: Minimize loan logs; data may remain private and may be deleted under the authorization rules.

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 工作人员培训、纸质教程和数据删除请求必须可独立提供支持。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: Staff training, a paper tutorial, and a data-deletion request must independently provide support.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录培训、借用、归还和数据处理选择的最小状态；不衡量社区规模或环境绩效。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record minimal states for training, loan, return, and data-handling choice; do not measure community scale or environmental performance.

human_gate.gate_zh: 工作人员确认培训、设备权利、数据选择和可删除路径后，才可借用；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: Staff must confirm training, device rights, data choice, and deletion path before a loan; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 设备未校准、培训缺失、数据权利不明或删除请求无法处理时，停止借用并撤回相关数据。
stop_exit.en: Stop loans and withdraw related data when the device is uncalibrated, training is missing, data rights are unclear, or a deletion request cannot be handled.

risk.zh: 未校准读数被过度解释，或借用数据超出必要范围。
risk.en: Uncalibrated readings could be overinterpreted, or loan data could exceed what is necessary.

space_type_and_status.space_type_zh: 遗址公园展示节点；铁路记忆导览候选界面
space_type_and_status.space_type_en: Heritage-park display nodes; candidate railway-memory guide interface
space_type_and_status.status_zh: 临时概念建议，未安装、未批准
space_type_and_status.status_en: Provisional concept proposal; not installed or approved

data_and_rights.inputs_zh: 清权档案、官方文本和人工译校
data_and_rights.inputs_en: Cleared archives, official texts, and human translation
data_and_rights.rights_zh: 史料逐条人工核读；静态图文和人工讲解并行，不使用未授权肖像、商标或图像。
data_and_rights.rights_en: Review historical material item by item; provide static text and human interpretation in parallel, without unauthorized portraits, marks, or images.

operating_generic_roles.label_zh: 无障碍与公共利益审查人

manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_zh: 静态文字、纸质导览和人工讲解必须可独立提供内容。
manual_or_static_baseline.baseline_en: Static text, a paper guide, and human interpretation must independently provide the content.

metric_definition.definition_zh: 记录导览条目的史料、权利、译校和人工发布复核状态；不衡量文化传播效果。
metric_definition.definition_en: Record provenance, rights, translation, and human-publication review state for each guide entry; do not measure cultural communication effect.

human_gate.gate_zh: 文史审查人确认史实、权利、译文和无障碍表达后，才可发布条目；HumanDecision 仍待完成。
human_gate.gate_en: A heritage reviewer must confirm history, rights, translation, and accessible expression before an entry is released; HumanDecision remains pending.

stop_exit.zh: 史实、版权、译文或人工核读不能确认时，撤下动态内容并恢复已核实的静态文字、纸质导览和人工讲解。
stop_exit.en: Withdraw dynamic content and restore verified static text, the paper guide, and human interpretation when history, rights, translation, or human review cannot be confirmed.

risk.zh: 史实、权利或翻译错误损害文化叙事和公众信任。
risk.en: Historical, rights, or translation errors could harm cultural narrative and public trust.
